evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Not present. Rep jumps directly into collecting foundation information (email, phone, address) without framing the call time or waiting for a yes.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: All four gathered: Name (Jen Nicholson), moving day (Thursday October 22nd), route (Apollo beach to Newport Richey), size (approximately 1400 sq ft, two bedroom villa).
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'Did you have any like, concerns or questions that you wanted me to kick you off with?' — but this comes after already starting to collect information (email). Customer responds with pricing concern. Rep asks again during info gathering: 'While I'm keying in this information that you have like any top of my concerns or questions just like off the top.' — asked after probing has begun.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises pricing concern ('my questions are concerned...pricing'). Rep acknowledges but does not dig deeper with 'tell me more about that.' Rep pivots directly to email collection. Shallow follow-up.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection summary given. Rep acknowledges concerns exist but never mirrors back what was heard.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Comprehensive coverage: property type (villa), floor/stories (one story), number of rooms (2 bedrooms + office/guest room, another small room at new location), walking distance/parking access (street parking, garage backup possible, some uncertainty), additional rooms (office, sunroom at destination), special considerations (old buffet with wooden shelf that's hard to reinstall, fine picture 3x4 feet, TV to be packed, adjustable king mattress). All seven items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes — 'You will not need any help with packing, like, packing services for that day?' Customer declines (wants to pack themselves).
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes — 'total boxes not including those bins. What would you say that might look like as far as a box count?' Customer responds: 'at least fifteen boxes.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full. Rep provides hourly rate ($285 for 3 movers + 1 truck) and duration (7–8 hours including 1.5-hour drive). Then gives personalized budget range: '$2,135 to about $2,420' — anchored to the specific home size, items listed (disassembly/reassembly of adjustable king, special care for buffet), and distance traveled.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Trip fee disclosed upfront ($140 for 1.5-hour distance), included in estimate. Taxes and insurance already built in. 'Pay only for time you use' framing provided ('if it takes 6 to 7 hours instead of 7 to 8, that's all you pay'). Mentions not charging for travel time to customer location. No explicit '2.5-hour minimum' or '15-minute increments' language, but 'time you use' covers the spirit.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After giving the estimate and framing, customer expresses surprise about 7–8 hours. Rep clarifies the drive is included. Customer then says 'I'm gonna need to talk to my husband but I feel really comfortable' — at no point does rep ask 'Does that feel fair?' or create intentional silence for customer to absorb and respond.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full. Rep states: 'If for whatever reason we don't arrive within that window that we said then, money is automatically deducted off of your final bill.' Discount terms clearly stated.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Partial. Rep mentions: 'we also have our extra protection worry damage coverage that's already included in that does cover-up to $2,000 for any incidentals' — the $2,000 coverage and 'included in' (not an add-on) are both stated. However, no explicit 'no deductible / no fine print' framing is delivered; rep does not say 'no deductible' or address fine print concerns directly.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. Rep does not ask a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' After delivering both promises, rep pivots to: 'I have the other piece is that you do only pay for the time you use' (repeating the time framing already covered in Section 4), and then addresses the lift-gate truck availability. No closing question.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. After the estimate is delivered and customer says 'I'm gonna need to talk to my husband but I feel really comfortable,' rep responds with information about the lift-gate truck and availability. No genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' is asked. No final concerns check occurs.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False. Rep does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent catch-all.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Customer volunteers 'I'm gonna need to talk to my husband but I feel really comfortable and you have great reviews so we'll see but I, I'm, I really, I'll call you back.' Rep responds supportively but never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any clear ask for the business. Rep instead confirms the lift-gate truck availability and says 'It is free to reserve' — offering information, not asking for a commitment.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: False. No mention of rate lock or 'hold this price for X days' commitment.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Customer's phone number confirmed at start of call (established as 'best number'). Date confirmed (October 22nd). Arrival window: not specified. Crew size: 3 movers mentioned in estimate, not re-confirmed at close. Addresses: both addresses confirmed during probing (pick-up and drop-off). Notes for crew: No explicit notes left about customer concerns (e.g., the buffet shelf issue, fine picture, TV packing, owner's items in garage not to be moved). Rep does capture these concerns during discovery but does not explicitly log them as crew notes or confirm they'll be passed along.

top_strength: Chauntelle gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, room count, parking, all large items, special considerations like the old buffet and fine artwork) and managed a complex inventory conversation with clear confirmation, which set up an accurate and personalized estimate.
coaching_note: Never ask for the business — the call ends with the customer volunteering to call back after talking to her husband, but Chauntelle never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any explicit close, missing the core ask in Section 7.
